claims.public_claim: IREN reported FY26 total revenue of $707.0m, AI Cloud Services revenue of $128.8m, and net loss of $702.6m.
claims.evidence_boundary: Historic issuer financial statement amounts. They do not establish future revenue, cash collection, or AI Cloud profitability.
claims.what_would_change_it: Compare with the next filed quarterly report on or after 2026-11-05.

claims.public_claim: IREN reported FY26 non-cash impairment of assets of $638.8m, primarily related to decommissioning Bitcoin mining hardware as sites were converted for AI Cloud growth.
claims.evidence_boundary: An impairment is an accounting charge and is not equivalent to cash expenditure or total conversion cost.
claims.what_would_change_it: Review subsequent filed impairment and asset-disposition notes.

claims.public_claim: IREN disclosed a five-year Microsoft GPU-cloud agreement with an approximately $9.7bn headline contract value.
claims.evidence_boundary: The disclosure was furnished by IREN. Headline contract value is not recognized revenue or cash collected.
claims.what_would_change_it: Review any amendment, termination, delivery, revenue-recognition, or collection disclosure.

claims.public_claim: IREN stated that Horizon 1 was delivered to and accepted by Microsoft in August 2026 and that NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud status was achieved on GB300 NVL72.
claims.evidence_boundary: This is issuer-reported acceptance in a furnished exhibit, not a Microsoft-authored acceptance record or independent NVIDIA certification record captured by this tracker.
claims.what_would_change_it: Seek a customer-authored or independently attributable acceptance artifact.

claims.public_claim: IREN reported $4bn contracted ARR for 2026 capacity and $1bn operating ARR as of August 26, 2026.
claims.evidence_boundary: IREN defines ARR from contracted GPU-hour pricing for commissioned GPUs multiplied by 8,760 hours plus storage and ancillaries. ARR is non-GAAP and recognized revenue may be materially lower.
claims.what_would_change_it: Check the Q1 FY27 release and filing for changed definitions and realized GAAP revenue.

claims.public_claim: IREN reported $3.6bn of investment-grade GPU financing for the Microsoft contract at a 6.0% weighted-average interest rate, excluding fees.
claims.evidence_boundary: An issuer financing disclosure does not by itself establish full project funding, future drawdown, repayment economics, or returns.
claims.what_would_change_it: Review filed debt, collateral, drawdown, fee, covenant, and repayment disclosures.

claims.public_claim: A Microsoft-authored Horizon 1 acceptance record is present in the reviewed source set.
claims.speaker_attribution: StructEvidence — bounded state derived from the reviewed source set
claims.evidence_boundary: The reviewed acceptance statement is authored by IREN. Missing customer-authored evidence is a gap, not evidence that acceptance did not occur.
claims.what_would_change_it: Check official Microsoft publications and future IREN filings for an attributable customer record.

claims.public_claim: Horizons 2, 3, and 4 had been delivered and accepted by the evidence cutoff.
claims.speaker_attribution: StructEvidence — bounded state derived from the reviewed source set
claims.evidence_boundary: IREN reported Horizon 2 commissioning and Horizons 3–4 in late-stage construction, targeting Q4 2026 delivery. Its Form 10-K says contractual delivery grace periods extend from mid-Q4 2026 to the beginning of Q2 2027. A target or outer bound is not a completed acceptance event.
claims.what_would_change_it: 2026-11-05 Q1 FY27 results, then any later 8-K or customer-authored acceptance record.

claims.public_claim: Contracted ARR has converted into the same amount of GAAP recognized revenue.
claims.speaker_attribution: StructEvidence — bounded state derived from the reviewed source set
claims.evidence_boundary: Contracted ARR, operating ARR, recognized revenue, deferred revenue, prepayments, and cash are different measures.
claims.what_would_change_it: Compare subsequent filed AI Cloud revenue and notes with the exact ARR definition then in use.

claims.public_claim: The approximately $9.7bn Microsoft headline contract value has been collected in cash.
claims.speaker_attribution: StructEvidence — bounded state derived from the reviewed source set
claims.evidence_boundary: The reviewed materials disclose contract value, prepayments, deferred revenue, and financing but do not establish collection of the full headline value.
claims.what_would_change_it: Review filed cash-flow, deferred-revenue, receivable, and contract-liability disclosures.

claims.public_claim: The mining-to-AI transition is complete and produces positive returns after operating costs, financing, and capital investment.
claims.speaker_attribution: StructEvidence — bounded state derived from the reviewed source set
claims.evidence_boundary: Historic revenue growth, one reported acceptance event, impairment, financing, and construction targets do not establish completion or full-life economic returns.
claims.what_would_change_it: Review subsequent segment results, costs, capex, impairment, operating capacity, and transition language.
